title: Continuity Head contradiction guard
mission: Implement a deterministic read-only verifier that cross-checks activity assertions in CONTINUITY_HEAD against exact claims, runs, recovery claims and durable returns; emit machine-auditable contradiction receipts when newer evidence disproves an asserted live state, without rewriting authority surfaces.

unblock_value.reason: Workers are required to reconstruct exact live state before allocation; machine-detecting stale head assertions prevents false recovery or duplicate work decisions.

information_gain.reason: The live contradiction proves that a compact continuity projection can diverge from exact durable opportunity evidence even when the head itself is newer than the return.

regression_prevention.reason: A deterministic verifier can make stale projection contradictions visible before workers act on them, while preserving the rule that projection files do not override exact evidence.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Automatic contradiction receipts reduce the need for a human to notice and explain stale control-plane projections across many parallel workers.

falsification.claim_to_test: A deterministic verifier can identify stale activity assertions in CONTINUITY_HEAD from exact durable evidence without treating projections as authority.
falsification.disconfirming_evidence: The verifier flags a non-contradictory head, misses the observed progress-metrics contradiction on pinned inputs, depends on directory enumeration order, or mutates authority state.
falsification.pass_condition: Pinned fixtures and live evidence produce deterministic contradiction/no-contradiction results with exact source refs and no authority mutation.
falsification.boundary: This proposal does not authorize rewriting CONTINUITY_HEAD, promoting opportunity state, or treating every older projection field as false merely because newer unrelated commits exist.

dedup_note: Exact repository search found no prior continuity-head contradiction/freshness verifier proposal for this observed stale still_active assertion. The repository-host proposal-pin race proposal was found and excluded as a duplicate lane before this fingerprint was pinned.
